welcome.title: Welcome to Knowitball ⚽
welcome.description:
Free football games in your browser, made by three fans: **Harry, Mikey and Leo**.

**Road to the Golden Ball**: start as a nobody, take every chance yourself, chase the Ballon d'Or.
**Tierlists**, **Draft**, **daily grids** and more.

**▶ Play now: https://knowitball.co.uk**

You are early. What you say in this server changes the game: we read every suggestion and bug report and we ship updates most days.

welcome.title: Get going in 60 seconds
welcome.description:
1. Read <#rules>
2. Pick your games and pings in **Channels & Roles** (top of the channel list)
3. Say hi in <#intro>
4. Play, then post your career in <#careers>
5. Found a bug? <#bugs>. Got an idea? <#ideas>.

rules.title: The rules
rules.description:
**1.** Be decent. Banter about clubs is fine; abuse, racism, sexism or homophobia is an instant ban.
**2.** No spam, scams, ads or self-promo outside <#careers> and <#goals>.
**3.** Keep it safe for younger fans: no NSFW, no gore.
**4.** No cheating tools or save editing shared publicly.
**5.** The mods have the final say. Follow Discord's Terms: https://discord.com/terms

play.title: Every game, free
play.description:
**Road to the Golden Ball** (career): https://knowitball.co.uk

All on **https://knowitball.co.uk**. Sign in with Google to keep your saves on any device.

events.title: Weekly challenge
events.description: Every week a new challenge in <#challenge>: e.g. *win the league with a League Two club*, *score 50 in one season*, *best tierlist of all-time strikers*. Winners get a shout-out, a role, and their name in the next update.
